actionability.next_action: Arrange an Epoch-hosted evaluation against the immutable model endpoint; no local substitute is valid.

blockers: Any local math result (GSM8K, MATH-500, AIME, MathArena) is a different benchmark and must never be reported under frontiermath_eval.

Evaluation is HOSTED BY EPOCH AI, not submitted to a portal. A FrontierMath number requires Epoch to run the eval on their own infrastructure against a model they can reach (public API, pre-release access, or a UI session their staff drive). This is an organisational agreement, not a credential this repo can set.
No grader is public. Reference solutions and the answer-checking logic ship with the private set. The public transcripts contain neither ground truth nor verdicts, so nothing here is gradable.

No official FrontierMath dataset exists on Hugging Face or GitHub. Every repo claiming to be FrontierMath is a solver or a reconstruction and cannot produce a comparable score. Using one would be fabrication.

TERMINAL — the dataset is never released. Epoch AI is contractually unable to share Tiers 1-4 questions and answers without OpenAI's written permission. There is no download, no gated Hugging Face repo, no data-use agreement, and no request form that yields the problems. No local action can ever unblock this lane.

The public sample corpus (150 transcripts over the ORIGINAL 5 public problems from the 2024 paper) is characterization evidence only. It is ~1.5% of the 338-problem post-v2 private set, is outdated relative to the 12 problems Epoch currently publishes, and is not a benchmark split.
claim_boundary: Modal preflight is infrastructure evidence, never a benchmark score.
